risk_note: RV2 by path (catalog is RV1; rule tests under test/** are RV2). S17-c1 (D10-891 ①; union plan s17-shop-entry-plan-20261107.md §二-3): ① shop_entry on the detail card is true only when shop.entry.enabled.<platform> is exactly true, shop.entry.source.<platform> is configured, the platform adapter declares shopConvertSources containing that source, and the item carries both shop_ref and shop_name (CT-26zb S2: the shop name is required); keys and adapter are taken by the product's own platform; only configuration and the adapter declaration are read, nothing is asked of the union (an adapter lookup error counts as not declared). Production wiring passes shopAdapters in catalog.module.ts. ② search, hot rank and detail write product_refs.shop_id from the union shop_ref; the upsert keeps an existing shop_id when the new one is null (COALESCE). ③ read-only port shopOf(appId, productKey, itemRef?) for linking, exported from catalog/index.ts: answers from the detail cache only when it holds both shop_ref and shop_name (product_refs has no shop name column), never the union, never across apps. Frozen detail-extras cases unchanged (their item has no shop_name; their adapters declare no source). No amount change.

reviews.note: Codex review (D10-823, effort medium) round 1 pass with no findings; codex-run refused a general review because the task is RV2 by path, so the money checklist was used.

longrun.note: no change under test/properties, packages/money, packages/domain or packages/testing; the required longrun-props check runs on the PR head
